The '''Central Arizona Florence Correctional Complex''', formerly Central Arizona Detention Center and Florence Correctional Complex, is a privately owned and operated managed prison for men and women located in [[Florence, Arizona|Florence]], [[Pinal County, Arizona]]. The facility is run by [[Corrections Corporation of America]] and houses prisoners for the [[United States Marshals Service]] (USMS), TransCor America LLC, [[U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] (ICE), [[Pascua Yaqui Tribe]], [[United States Air Force]], and [[Mesa, Arizona|City of Mesa]].

The 434,000 square foot facility opened in 1994 and is located on 73 acres of land. The facility has approximately 20 housing units. The [[U.S. Marshal Service]] holds the majority of the housing units, [[U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] holds one housing unit, and The City of Mesa is in a shared housing unit. The average population of inmates and detainees is 3,555.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/2828926-2013-Central-Arizona-Detention-Center-Florence-AZ.html|title=2013 ODO Inspection - Central Arizona Detention Center Florence AZ|last=Center)|first=Jennifer Chan (National Immigrant Justice|website=www.documentcloud.org|language=en|access-date=2018-12-14}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/2828925-2012-Central-ArizonaDetentioncenter-Florence-AZ.html|title=2012 ODO Inspection - Central Arizona Detention Center Florence AZ|last=Center)|first=Jennifer Chan (National Immigrant Justice|website=www.documentcloud.org|language=en|access-date=2018-12-14}}</ref>
